no-impression.label: No impression
no-impression.description: You cannot recall the topic or document at all. Review again in 1 day.

familiar.label: Looks familiar
familiar.description: You remember seeing it but cannot describe the content. Review again in 3 days.

remembered-not-understood.label: Remembered, not understood
remembered-not-understood.description: You remember the content but never truly understood it. Add it to the relearning queue.

partially-mastered.label: Partially mastered
partially-mastered.description: You understand the main ideas but still have gaps. Review again in at least 7 days.

mastered.label: Mastered
mastered.description: You can explain or apply it without the document. Review again in at least 30 days.
